summary: Listed as a lookout in Marion County; no build, staffing or current-condition source found. The community is spelled Blitchton today.

evidence.supports: location given as a township and range, not an agency

evidence.quote: A post office called Blichton was established in 1888, and remained in operation until it was discontinued in 1917

evidence.supports: community named for Dr. Simeon Hardee Blitch
evidence.quote: The community was named for Dr. Simeon Hardee Blitch.

evidence.supports: Blitch was a doctor and dentist
evidence.quote: He became a doctor and dentist

evidence.supports: Blitch later served as state senator from Marion County
evidence.quote: Dr. Blitch went on to become the State Senator from Marion County, Florida.

evidence.supports: community formed at a crossing of two wagon trails
evidence.quote: In time, the area to the west of that intersection and the intersection itself became Blitchton.

evidence.supports: the trails are now State Highways 326 and 27
evidence.quote: Today those trails have become the intersecting highways of Highway 326 and State Highway 27.

corrections.why: The community is spelled Blitchton today; Blichton was the spelling of its 1888 to 1917 post office
The Eastern US Forest Lookouts page gives a township and range land description, which is not an agency

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Eastern US Forest Lookouts index uses Blichton, the 1888 post office spelling; Wikipedia uses Blitchton for the community today

notes_for_editor: Only the Eastern US Forest Lookouts index places a lookout here (name, Marion County, coordinates). A 2016 Florida tower list held in the crawl cache, whose source has no stable URL and so is not cited, names a Blitchton Forestry Lookout Tower at 29.27111, -82.33111 in Marion County; the record's coordinates are within about 25 m of it. No NHLR, FFLOS or Florida Forest Service record was reachable. Build date, agency, staffing, height and current condition are unknown. The agency field held a township and range description and is proposed for correction. The story names the lookout as Blichton, the spelling the site uses, and the community as Blitchton, the spelling in use today. The Wikipedia article spells the namesake's middle name both Hardee and Hardy; the story keeps the Hardee spelling used in the quoted sentence. The map position is an embedded map point in the page HTML at 29.27129, -82.33126 (zoom 10), not visible text, so it has no quote in evidence.
